meta.method: Boxes on facades (crops in crops/, numbered by sample index). rgb = median of the dominant colour cluster (window glass/deep openings under luma 55 ignored) = the wall AS SEEN incl. stains; paint_rgb = the same on the brightest 40% of the box = the cleanest paint; raw_median = plain median of the whole box. darker_than_wall_share = share of box pixels 28-82% darker than the wall colour (stains, grime, shadow lines). Light: sun / overcast / shade-bright; dusk photos excluded (market_shed/suburb_teashop_shed; condo_tower/skyline_modern not sampled). Families are by paint_rgb (HSV: S<0.10 or warm S<0.16 = neutral).
